name: Radcliff Wire Inc
old_description: Radcliff Wire routinely works with over 60 different metals to expertly produce standard and custom wire in a broad variety of shapes, sizes, and finishes.
about:
Radcliff Wire, Inc. is based in Bristol, Connecticut, a historic center of spring manufacturing in the eastern United States. The company began over six decades ago as a supplier of hard-to-find flat and shaped wire to spring makers, and word of its quality and reliability spread quickly.

Today Radcliff Wire produces flat, square, and custom-profiled wire in more than 60 metals and alloys. It manages the entire production chain in-house, from raw-material certification through drawing, shaping, and final inspection. The facility maintains a suite of testing equipment — including Rockwell and micro-hardness testers, tensile testers, laser micrometers, and optical comparators — to verify mechanical properties and dimensional accuracy on every order.

The company serves a diverse industrial base that includes aerospace, electronics, medical devices, automotive, and consumer-products manufacturers. Its wire goes into springs, contacts, surgical components, and other precision parts where consistent metallurgy and tight geometry are critical.

Radcliff Wire attributes its longevity to a quality system certified to ISO 9001:2015, a cross-trained workforce that averages 15 years of experience, and a compliance program that covers REACH, RoHS, conflict-minerals, and DFARS requirements. The firm was founded to fill a gap in the spring-wire market and continues to focus on delivering the exact wire specification a customer needs, when they need it.
